_about: Curated record of documented mass-atrocity events against the Rohingya, read by remembrance.html. Each event must come from a credible, public investigation and link to its source. This is edited by hand (never auto-ingested): add an event by appending an object below with place, township, date, summary and a source + url. Keep summaries factual, sober and non-graphic; no personal data about individuals.

events.summary: UN investigators estimate around 750 Rohingya were killed, and the village was burned to the ground. The Fact-Finding Mission described it as a well-planned, deliberate attack on a specific civilian population.
Physicians for Human Rights documented an estimated 400 villagers killed or missing, including 99 children, and a group of 50 men who were taken away and never seen again.

After soldiers overran the village, survivors described several mass graves. Village elders recorded 75 names; local estimates ran as high as 400 killed. First documented by the Associated Press in 2018.
An initial survey counted 147 Inn Din villagers killed; Reuters documented the execution of ten detained men. Two Reuters journalists were jailed for reporting the killings.
